scope: TEST49 + additional143; CAL46 excluded from quantitative diagnostic
interpretation: Oracle minimum translation is a postseal ceiling diagnostic only; its pose is never selected at runtime. It ignores rotation accuracy.

The full cached bank includes rejected/unfeasible proposals; NMS tokens are independently fresh-feasible under its own fixed control constraints. Empty banks remain explicit and fallback metric is separate.

WD pixel tests use archived B/I q and old effective covariance, no S/O/U/T coordinates. Some archives are no longer final complete point likelihoods. Two family minima can be different physical poses.

2/3/6px and max effective Mah3 are descriptive sensitivity levels, not calibrated predictive coverage or runtime thresholds. Both families have a representative within the level and their separate q-fit representatives differ >5cm.
No new optimization, training, source/model parameter selection or error/ID routing. Current reference poses are annotation-derived and signed-axis contracts remain limited.
